PD Bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=svc-inference-prod (high) — 2471112223
Incident Bot: Incident thread created • incident_id=INC-20247 • severity=sev2

Alex P: got the page, acking now. seeing multiple pages across support and sre. anyone else? :eyes:
Sara M: acked. which service was paged? PD summary is a bit terse.
Jun Li: I got a duplicate page too. looks like Support and SRE both got the same page. not expected.
Alex P: PD shows target "svc-inference-prod" but routing key indicates binding to "support-oncall" and "sre-primary" simultaneously.
Kelsey R: that sounds like a schedule binding overlap. we had a night override for contractors last week — did that get applied as a permanent override?
Contractor Oncall: i was temporarily added for weekend coverage but i removed the override yesterday. i didn't get notified i was still in rotation this morning.
Sara M: timeline: page -> PD auto-escalate -> both teams paged -> duplicate alerts flooded phone trees. customer-facing errors reported for ~8 minutes per logs.
Jun Li: checking PD audit logs...

Jun Li: ```
# pd audit tail
2026-03-14T01:12:03Z binding.create service=svc-inference-prod target=support-oncall actor=automation-sync
2026-03-14T01:12:07Z binding.create service=svc-inference-prod target=sre-primary actor=automation-sync
2026-03-14T01:15:01Z override.apply schedule=contractors-night actor=oncall-admin
```

Alex P: automation-sync user is our schedule sync job. looks like it reapplied an old override state during nightly sync window. that rebind caused PD to treat both groups as primary.
Kelsey R: predicted fallout: duplicate pages + exhausted acknowledgement chain -> escalation loop.
Sara M: customer impact: errors in inference HTTP 500 rate spiked 01:10–01:20 UTC, about 6% failed requests, hitting SLAs. need incident timeline and mitigation notes.
Alex P: mitigation: 1) removed the erroneous binding in PD (manual unbind), 2) applied a temporary emergency override to route to sre-primary only, 3) muted duplicate noise for support team.

Alex P: commands I ran: ```
pd service remove-binding svc-inference-prod support-oncall --actor=alex.p
pd schedule override create contractors-night --expires=2026-03-14T02:00:00Z --note="temp fix"
```

PD Bot: binding removed by alex.p • binding.id=bnd-9f3a • success
Incident Bot: emergency override applied • override_id=ovr-77a

Jun Li: confirmed customer error rate is trending down after 01:18 UTC. no new pages after reroute.
Kelsey R: who should own the follow-up? looks like schedule sync logic needs a guard to ignore stale overrides.
Sara M: Ops Oncall? cc @Platform Eng. we'll need an RCA and an action item to add validation to automation-sync.

Kelsey R: immediate actions (assigned during thread):
- Jun Li: submit postmortem stub with timeline and impact stats (ETA today EOD)
- Platform Eng (triage): add validation that automation-sync ignores overrides older than 24h (PR by next week)
- Alex P: add PD runbook snippet for manual unbind + emergency override steps
- SRE: run dedup config to avoid duplicate targets in binding responses

Alex P: added short runbook note in #eng-oncall: "If automation-sync reapplies bindings unexpectedly, remove extra bindings and apply single-team override; escalate to Platform if sync replays more than once." :memo:

Contractor Oncall: fyi — i had left the rotation UI but apparently LDAP/SSO state still listed me in contractors-night. i can share screenshots.
Jun Li: that indicates source-of-truth mismatch between SSO group and PD automation feed. root cause likely in the sync pipeline.

Sara M: mitigation status: customer impact window ~10m, mitigation removed excess bindings, pages contained. Severity -> postmortem to determine action items and whether to adjust SLAs.

Kelsey R: temporary rollback steps documented. suggestion: add a pre-check in automation-sync: if a binding change would increase recipients >2 and happened in a non-business hour, block and flag for human review.

Alex P: leaving this thread open for follow-ups. tagging Platform Eng in case someone wants to pick up the automation fix: @Platform Eng
Jun Li: I'll start the postmortem doc and link logs. adding PD audit entries + Kinesis logs.
Sara M: thanks all. great quick containment. please add any missing artifacts to the incident doc. :thumbsup:

PD Bot: Incident INC-20247 status -> mitigated (by alex.p) • resolved_at=2471113550
Incident Bot: thread closed but keeping for follow-ups — assign owners in the doc.
